title: SimFdSlot.in_buf/out_buf[65536] hardcoded without named constant or comment
description: crypto2dev_sim.c SimFdSlot has 'byte in_buf[65536]; byte out_buf[65536];' — hardcoded 64KB. There is no named constant (e.g. CRYPTO2DEV_SIM_MAX_DATA) and no comment explaining the limit. A contributor who adds a large-input test will silently get EMSGSIZE from sim_write() without knowing why. The struct is 128KB+ per slot, 2MB total for 16 slots — worth calling out as a known limitation of the test simulator. Suggested fix: define SIM_MAX_DATA 65536 and add a comment noting the limit is a simulator constraint, not a wire-protocol constraint.
